product_one_liner.value: AmplifAI unifies contact-center data and uses AI-powered quality analysis, coaching, and next-best actions to improve performance for customer-experience teams and their human and AI agents.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link or plan page was found in the navigation or footer; the site directs buyers to request a demo.

named_customers.notes: Named in the customer case-study catalogue.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 168 associated employees, supporting this band rather than relying on its broader 51–200 company-size category.

hq_location.notes: Headquarters listed at 500 N Central Expy, Suite 500, Plano, Texas.

founded_year.notes: The company-hosted article explicitly states that the company was founded in 2016; this takes precedence over LinkedIn's conflicting 2020 entry.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog contains customer-experience guides, product marketing, industry commentary and company news, not a qualifying engineering blog with two engineer-authored accounts of how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation, help-center or developer-portal link appears in the reviewed navigation, footer or integration catalogue.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists only Senior .Net Full Stack Developer – Plano; no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title is listed.

model_provider.notes: The trust page names internally hosted open-source models such as LLaMA and says customer data does not touch public APIs such as ChatGPT. Microsoft Azure is described as infrastructure, not evidence of Azure OpenAI use.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the company's public certification/compliance claims; HIPAA and GDPR are compliance regimes rather than independent certifications.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 23, 2025, led by CVS Health Ventures. The announced $33.7 million combines Series B funding and a credit facility; a separate equity-only amount was not disclosed in the reviewed announcement.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 23, 2025 announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists only a Senior .Net Full Stack Developer role, with no SDR, BDR or account executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying dated product or major-feature launch was found within May 9–November 9, 2026 in the readable blog/news history. The AmplifAI 3.0 announcement is dated November 10, 2026, after the requested run date, and was excluded. The earlier explicit launch announcement reviewed was dated June 20, 2022.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Leslie Goodwin joined AmplifAI as Vice President Client Integration in January 2026 and became Senior Vice President, Healthcare Strategy & Growth in May 2026, within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are explicitly listed in AmplifAI's integration catalogue. This establishes supported integrations, not necessarily internal use by its own sales or marketing team.
